name: PDF Processing
tagline: Read, extract, merge, split, rotate, encrypt, and create PDFs — complete PDF manipulation guide.
description: Comprehensive PDF processing skill covering all common operations: reading and extracting text/tables from PDFs, merging and splitting PDFs, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs. Includes Python libraries (pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab) and command-line tools (qpdf, pdftotext, pdftk). Detailed examples for every task.
author: anthropics
suitable_for: Extracting text and tables from PDFs
